The *Cittasamuṭṭhānaduka* (Patthana 8.39) is a section of the Paṭṭhāna, the seventh and final treatise of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The text systematically investigates conditional causal relations through the framework of the Abhidhamma dyad (*duka*) concerning dhammas originated by consciousness or mind (*cittasamuṭṭhāna*) [SuttaCentral].
